justification: Inspected `proto/src/main/java/com/google/gson/protobuf/ProtoTypeAdapter.java`, `proto/pom.xml`, `proto/README.md`, and the four functional tests under `proto/src/test/java/com/google/gson/protobuf/functional/`. The package contains a single production class, and its outgoing dependencies are on Gson, protobuf, and Guava. Incoming use is limited to those 4 test files; no production class in the repo imports `com.google.gson.protobuf`. With no evidence that this package is a highly depended-on stable package that depends on less-stable packages, the unstable-dependency smell is not present.
